verdict: Paid campaigns have been dark since Aug 6; organic demand remains real.
narrative: Meta ads stopped running on August 6 and have not resumed — for the past 11 days, paid spend, paid clicks, and paid leads have all been zero. Before the pause, campaigns were accelerating: spend had reached roughly $215 per day in the final three days of activity, and the 28-day cost per lead of $25.35 across 50 leads was holding at an efficient level. Organic signals are still alive — your Google Business Profile drove 57 calls and 111 website clicks this period, and search clicks rose week over week — but without a paid funnel running, that demand has nowhere to go. Campaigns are being reactivated this week, and separately, the CRM intake workflow is being reviewed so that leads entering the pipeline convert to booked appointments.

highlights.phrase: consecutive days with zero paid spend or leads as of today
cost per lead in the 28 days before campaigns paused, across 50 leads
direct calls driven by your Google Business Profile this period, with no paid support

watch_item.issue: 36 contacts arrived before the pause but zero converted to booked appointments, pointing to a gap in intake or CRM workflow.
watch_item.fix: The intake and CRM workflow is being reviewed and corrected so leads entering the pipeline are followed up and scheduled.
